summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. announced via 8-K that wholly-owned subsidiaries commenced cash tender offers to purchase up to $350 million aggregate principal of their outstanding 5.144% Senior Notes due 2043 and 5.031% Senior Notes due 2046. The offers are subject to a maximum amount and typical conditions. No price per $1,000 principal, premium, or expiration date is stated in the filing. The board has not made a recommendation; no advisors are named. The mechanics involve the two subsidiaries as offerors, with the parent company consolidating the debt reduction. What to watch: final proration, acceptance priority, and market reaction to capital structure simplification.
